methodology.classification: fixed image form enum; production and reversed order alternate by round
methodology.baseline: one bounded perception per fixture; no classifier/advisory
methodology.replay: actual perceiveApprovedScreenshot, engine stubbed with measured real outputs, settings off vs assist; exact visual-result envelope byte comparison incl decision metadata; no actual browser/action
methodology.timing: synchronous C ABI only; worker decode/capture/transfer excluded; replay totalMs set to ABI ms; no chat tokens counted
methodology.accuracy: synthetic layout annotations only; neither user-intent routing nor tool selection accuracy
